name: Dave McCormick
summary: Record covers 10 of 10 issues, drawn from 10 archived campaign statements. States that veterans need access to quality health care, including mental health care. States support for a market-driven, all-of-the-above energy agenda including Pennsylvania natural gas, and for addressing climate change through adaptation rather than government spending. States support for a larger defense budget, a stronger defense industrial base and deterrence of adversaries.
asymmetry_note: Incumbents are judged on what they did (roll-call votes, sponsored bills). Challengers can only be judged on what they say (stated positions). These are not equivalent kinds of evidence; the record type is labeled on every item.

stances.summary: Dave McCormick advocated for American leadership in blockchain and cryptocurrency as critical to economic and national security. He supported bipartisan legislation such as the Financial Innovation and Technology for the 21st Century Act to establish clear regulatory rules that protect consumers while enabling continued innovation. McCormick highlighted the technology's grounding in principles of individual freedom, limited government, and privacy, along with its potential to support up to 4 million jobs by 2030 and benefit ecosystems in Pennsylvania cities including Allentown and Philadelphia.

sources.excerpt: Leaders in Congress must act to ensure America captures this next wave of innovation. They should embrace bipartisan efforts such as the Financial Innovation and Technology for the 21st Century Act, which would create clear rules for the industry to protect consumers while allowing for continued innovation.

posts.excerpt: Crypto and blockchain have the potential to create incredible jobs for our commonwealth and strengthen our national security. We need leaders who will embrace it and ensure America is leading the world in another generation of critical innovation.
Embracing crypto and blockchain will unlock great jobs for our commonwealth and benefit our national security. If Congress fails to accept the next wave of innovation, the U.S. will be left behind.

Families in PA would benefit from more access to the financial system. That's why I support cryptocurrency which cuts out powerful intermediaries. But Biden wants to tax the digital assets industry out of existence.

Blockchain & crypto offer PA and America the chance to lead another generation of innovation. But if policymakers don't do their part, this opportunity will slip away. I'll fight to ensure we remain at the tip of the technology spear.

stances.summary: McCormick called for a robust defense budget focused on next-generation warfare and restoring America’s military might. He advocated strengthening the defense industrial base and reestablishing deterrence against adversaries. McCormick endorsed plans to increase defense spending toward Cold War-era levels and supported generational investments in defense infrastructure such as shipyards. He expressed support for providing military aid to Ukraine and firm support for Israel. McCormick backed targeted use of U.S. military assets against fentanyl cartels in Mexico. As a combat veteran, he emphasized the need for quality health care and mental health care for veterans and supported adjusting veterans’ benefits with inflation.

sources.excerpt: As a combat veteran and a former deputy national security adviser, Dave knows we need a robust defense budget focused on equipping us for next generation warfare. As Senator, he’ll work to restore America’s military might, strengthen our defense industrial base... Dave knows that we need to equip our veterans with not just quality health care, but mental health care.

McCormick envisions using the U.S. military’s drones and special operations teams in Mexico to destroy fentanyl trafficking cartels... “What I’m saying is the combination of special operations and drones, I think, could eradicate the manufacturing facilities, kill the distribution networks and do a real dent in what is a terrorist activity.”

stances.summary: McCormick stated that the Affordable Care Act failed in its primary goals of reducing costs and enhancing access but does not support repealing it and instead favors making the law better. He expressed skepticism toward Medicare negotiating pharmaceutical prices and preferred competition to lower drug costs, while supporting a rollback of parts of the Inflation Reduction Act. McCormick said the government must keep its promises to protect Social Security and Medicare benefits and would not support changes for those near or in retirement. He advocated expanding mental health care access for veterans by removing certain Medicaid rules and supported measures to increase the supply of doctors and nurses through education and skilled worker programs.

sources.excerpt: McCormick said: “The best way to ensure that we get drug prices down and health care costs down is to make sure we have adequate competition. And having the government negotiate pharmaceutical prices, call me a skeptic, except maybe in very select cases, where we really do have significant price increases.”

posts.excerpt: Bob Casey wants to impose single-payer healthcare on Americans — another way of abolishing their private insurance.
As PA’s next Senator, I’ll fight for the strongest health care and mental health care for our veterans
Kamala Harris wants to raise your taxes so she can give free healthcare to illegal immigrants.

stances.summary: McCormick advocated fair trade rather than free trade, particularly with China. He called for revoking China’s permanent normal trade relations status and removing China from the World Trade Organization to ensure fairness for U.S. manufacturers and labor. McCormick stated general opposition to tariffs but supported their strategic and thoughtful use to achieve reciprocity and fair trade, including as leverage in negotiations such as steel tariffs. He prioritized American manufacturing in critical industries including steel, pharmaceuticals, and advanced manufacturing. McCormick supported investments in defense infrastructure to create union jobs in Pennsylvania manufacturing.

sources.excerpt: Congress must revoke China’s permanent normal trade relations status, and the United States must advocate for China’s removal from the WTO. ... I will be a champion for making generational investments in defense infrastructure that supports our national security—like reconstituting the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard—which will create union jobs right here in Pennsylvania.

“It’s important to have a real conversation about the value of fair trade — not free trade, but fair trade,” McCormick said. ... McCormick wants to remove China from the World Trade Organization and revoke its permanent normal trade relations status.

stances.summary: McCormick supported making the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent to maintain competitiveness and prevent tax increases. McCormick endorsed a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution while stating he would protect Social Security and Medicare benefits for those near or in retirement.
